value.title: F266 final: settled drains and retry multiplicity

sections.name: body
sections.value:
F266 final head47d828a9c33b855b7ad58eb7da9ecdc84fdac0a0 replaces the single drain count with started/ended and a borrowed DrainEnd drop guard.

Cost: one shared gate-mutex lookup per observer pane/pass, copying two u64s; replay uses the pre-existing observed() lock. Each owned-sink drain has two mutex/entry sections and two pane-key String allocations (begin/end), even for an existing entry. Guard storage is borrowed references, not a task/heap object. Metadata stays O(panes). At217 panes/600ms the added observer lookup rate is361.67/s.

2D+R is a settled short-drain model, not a duration-independent bound. While a drain spans ticks, settled()==None prevents a reusable baseline and the observer can capture once per pane/pass until it ends. The final PR now prices those ticks. No new poll, timer or launch site; inherited capture Fork and repair-reader launches still exist.

New C34 follow-up: "~4 drains per injection" is not general. CLEAR_REREADS=5; owned submission does two initial reads and leftover cleanup can do five more, seven per attempt before any outer fresh look. The reread path is pre-existing. Use measured drain starts D, not successful deliveries multiplied by four.

Evidence: interaction.rs:18,45-86,304-317,576-611,742-754,843-846; pane_observer.rs:506,564,677-750. CI44902854962/job136842221033/artifact14706289513:29 relevant JUnit cases passed, including the barrier regression; reviewer did not rerun mutants or real-tmux probes.

Historical R1 BEFORE201 panes/pass is not the217-pane scenario or proof of final-guard overhead/AFTER savings. Drain/repair cause attribution remains an accepted AFTER debt; aggregate captures/skips alone cannot identify D or R.

magicWand: cause and in-flight-duration counts in the existing observer cost receipt; separate unit cost from attempt-level reread multiplicity.
difficulties: C25 dependencies absent, boot not ready and quick gate red despite native/SDK passing. No build, source edit, install, live drain/repair or bounce. Final cost pass does not clear correctness/security findings; holding retained until merge.
